commercial_product.note: Sells consumer health and wellness supplements (non-drug) via subsidiary Best 365 Labs, Inc. Core technology is the MODS Max (Mineral Oxide Delivery System) bioavailability-enhancement process; product lines include NHTO/TPrime365 (testosterone/hormonal optimization supplement) and NAD+ supplements. None are FDA-approved drugs or devices in clinical trials.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Consumer health and wellness supplement company (dietary supplements via subsidiary Best 365 Labs). No proprietary drug or device clinical pipeline; no P1/P2/P3 trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.
